questions.question: What is the average product price in each category?
questions.generated_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many reviews has each star rating received?

questions.question: What is the total amount paid through each payment method?

questions.expected_sql: SELECT method, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM payments GROUP BY method

questions.question: Which country has the most customers?
questions.generated_sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country) SELECT country, customer_count FROM country_counts WHERE customer_count = (SELECT MAX(customer_count) FROM country_counts) ORDER BY country LIMIT 100
questions.expected_sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is our total revenue?

questions.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'

questions.question: Which product category earned the least revenue?
questions.generated_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 1
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which customers from Germany have placed more than 5 orders? Show the name and number of orders.

questions.question: What is the average number of days it took to ship orders placed in 2025?
questions.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(shipped_date) - JULIANDAY(order_date)), 2) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE NOT shipped_date IS NULL AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' LIMIT 100

questions.question: How many orders were placed in each quarter of 2024?
questions.generated_sql: SELECT 'Q' || ((CAST(STRFTIME('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter LIMIT 100
questions.expected_sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS q, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q

questions.question: How many days ago was the most recent order placed?
